reasoning.summary: The document is a 'CO-BRANDING AND ADVERTISING AGREEMENT' between i-Escrow and 2TheMart. Key terms include an effective date of June 21, 1999, a term of one year from the Launch Date with automatic renewal provisions, and California governing law. The contract involves co-branding, advertising fees based on transaction inquiries, IP ownership retention by each party, and specific termination rights including for change in company structure.

entries.evidence: "one (1) year following the Launch Date... automatically renewed for another one (1) year"
"This Agreement will be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California without giving effect to conflict of laws principles."
"advertising fees based on the number of Transaction Inquiries... calculated by multiplying 0.025% by the amount of the average Transaction"

"A party wishing to renew this Agreement shall give the other party notice thereof no less than thirty (30) days before the expiration of the term then in effect. In the event that either party does not give such notice, the term of this Agreement shall be automatically renewed for another one (1) year."

Present categories: Parties; Effective Date; Term/Expiration/Renewal language; Governing Law; Advertising Fees (Revenue/Profit Sharing); Audit Rights; IP Ownership Assignment; License Grant; Non-Transferable License; Change Of Control; Anti-Assignment; Termination For Convenience/Breach.

cuad_clauses: Parties: "by and between I-ESCROW, INC.... and 2THEMART.COM, INC."
Effective Date: "made as of June 21, 1999 (the 'Effective Date')"
Expiration Date: "The term of this Agreement shall continue for one (1) year following the Launch Date, unless earlier terminated"
Renewal Term: "This Agreement may be renewed for any number of successive one (1) year terms by mutual written agreement"
Notice Period To Terminate Renewal: "A party wishing to renew this Agreement shall give the other party notice thereof no less than thirty (30) days before the expiration of the term"
Governing Law: "This Agreement will be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California"
Revenue/Profit Sharing: "i-Escrow shall pay 2TheMart advertising fees based on the number of Transaction Inquiries"
Audit Rights: "Once every twelve (12) months, 2TheMart through a CPA may inspect and audit such records to verify reports."
Ip Ownership Assignment: "2TheMart and its suppliers retain all rights, title and interest in and to all intellectual property rights embodied in or associated with the 2TheMart Content"
License Grant: "2TheMart hereby grants to i-Escrow a worldwide, non-exclusive right to use, reproduce, distribute... the 2TheMart Content"
Non-Transferable License: "grants to 2TheMart a non-exclusive, nontransferable right to use the i-Escrow Marks"

Change Of Control: "If a majority of the equity securities of either 2TheMart or i-Escrow, Inc.... are acquired by another company during the term of this Agreement either company may terminate this Agreement"
Anti-Assignment: "All rights... granted herein are not sublicenseable, transferable or assignable."
